name: Usage question
about: Ask about configuring, running, or understanding Scope benchmarks.
---

Please do not report security vulnerabilities here. Follow [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/microsoft/scope/blob/main/SECURITY.md) instead.
Redact secrets and sensitive data from configuration, logs, and screenshots.

## Question

What are you trying to understand or accomplish in Scope, such as setting up a worker, submitting a run, configuring criteria, or interpreting scores?

## Setup and context

Include relevant details such as your Scope version, local or hosted deployment, CLI or Portal workflow, and agent/model combination.

## What you have tried

Link to the documentation you followed and describe the commands, configuration, or steps you tried. Include relevant output or a run/request ID if available.

## Desired outcome

Describe the result or explanation that would help you move forward.
